description:
When recognize that we are the ones creating the reaction, we can begin to free our true consciousness.

We are the CREATORS of our life, and can create the quality of life we want from anything life offers us.

#DateWithDestiny2025
transcript: No one triggers you. You trigger you. When you start to realize nothing is being done to you, you're the one doing it all. That's when you start to liberate yourself. Anyone on the outside who's a trigger is only a trigger you're using. You could say, how I trigger myself is I see these people and I picture or I say to myself or I do this to my body because that's how it really happens. There's no one to blame. Someone else can go by and have the same experience and not be triggered. So you're doing it. But we somehow forgot we're the one in charge here. And then you become enslaved to some pattern instead of waking up to your own true consciousness. Knowing the the eight extreme stress the only question is do you use stress or let stress use you do you create more stress by what you do in your own head or do you de-stress and move forward and use it as rocket fuel to make your life greater
